answer_1.quote: We asked the LLM to generate brief answers and admit "unsure" when its confidence is low.
answer_1.outputs: brief answers and "unsure" responses to factual questions

answer_2.quote: We adopt popular metrics, including exact match (EM), token F1 (F1), and ROUGE-L (RL)

answer_3.quote: We ask ChatGPT to check whether an answer is correct given the question and ground truth (Prompt 2 in Appendix A.1).

answer_4.quote: we randomly sampled 840 answers from the evaluated LLMs and manually checked whether human judgment agrees with the LLM-based metrics.
answer_4.guideline: manually checked whether human judgment agrees with the LLM-based metrics
